post_detection_relocation.parameter_rationale: Joint lite: reuse the first-round medium-tier ph2dt dt.ct verbatim (hash-tied to its solver evidence) together with the MESS-native dt.cc, IDAT=3. Newly detected events connect to the catalog network only through MESS cross-correlation links to their templates; no independent re-picking and no new ph2dt run. Effective joint link threshold OBSCC+OBSCT=4. Each CC tier is solved independently and keeps the project DAMP trials (spatial-evidence rule); values are explicit starting settings, not fitted optima.

parameter_rationale.profile: Initial working configuration; inspect regional applicability. No case-specific optimum is implied.
parameter_rationale.region: Researcher-specified analysis extent and datum; review before scientific computation.
parameter_rationale.relocation_ratio: Record source and applicability here when setting vp_vs_ratio. The supplied P/S model may have depth-varying ratios.
